findings.summary: The Nudge action is added to the Person screen and ActionBar, but both still cite world-spec section 6, which lists only Edit goal, Log contact and Open channel; the new affordance has no source and the new criterion has no sourceRefs, unlike its siblings.
findings.evidence: Actions are Edit goal, Log contact, Nudge and Open channel ... source: { doc: keep-in-touch-world-specification, section: "6" }; nudge affordance lacks a source field; C.webapp.nudge.single lacks sourceRefs

findings.summary: MessageDraft loses its provisional flag and is repurposed as the record for delivered nudges, which conflicts with its draft and no-autonomous-send semantics and with the source section that defined it only as a provisional draft.
findings.evidence: - provisional: true ... description: ... no autonomous send. Used for nudges; affordance effect: Delivers a short "thinking of you" card ... links: writes entity.MessageDraft

findings.summary: The affordance's failure list covers only the missing-Connection case, although its preconditions and the acceptance criterion also require refusal when either side has blocked the other.
findings.evidence: preconditions: [Active Connection ..., No block in either direction]; failure: [Not available when there is no active Connection]; claim: "... refused after disconnect or block"
